name: malt
description: Review changed code against project standards, explore interactive architecture maps, and compare Git branches with a local Claude reviewer.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Your next change starts here.
Save a file in a Git repository to see its changed blocks. MALT skips Git-ignored files and its own .malt folder. Select a block to jump to it; hover in the editor for the review.
[Start Reviewer](command:malt.startReviewer)
[Scan Project Standards](command:malt.scanStandards)

Review a GitHub pull request the same way MALT reviews your own changes: every changed block outlined and checked against your project standards, with plain-English hover cards.
MALT checks the pull request out in this workspace (it refuses if you have uncommitted changes) and returns you to your branch when you finish. Results stay in VS Code; nothing is posted to GitHub.
[Review Pull Request…](command:malt.reviewPullRequest)

malt.reviewer.autoStart.description: Start the reviewer automatically when a workspace opens.

enumDescriptions: Claude, through the Claude Code CLI in the reviewer
GitHub Copilot, through VS Code's Language Model API (asks for consent once)
Codex, in an isolated container per call (needs Docker and an OpenAI API key: MALT: Set Codex Credentials)
malt.reviewer.triageProvider.markdownDescription: Who answers **block overviews**. Machine-scoped, so a repository's settings can never choose which service receives its code. Choose a model for the provider too (**Models & effort** in the MALT Reviewer view lists each provider's models). Applies when the reviewer restarts.

malt.reviewer.triageCopilotModel.markdownDescription: GitHub Copilot model for this review type when its provider is `copilot`: a model id from **MALT: Detect Review Providers**, or `auto` for the first model Copilot offers. Kept separate from the Claude model, and user-level like the provider, so switching provider never pairs one provider with another's model.

malt.reviewer.triageCodexModel.markdownDescription: Codex model for this review type when its provider is `codex`: an OpenAI model id, or `auto` for Codex's default model. Kept separate from the other providers' models, and user-level like the provider, so switching provider never pairs one provider with another's model.

malt.reviewer.triageModel.markdownDescription: Claude model for **block overviews** (one call per changed block). An alias (`haiku`, `sonnet`, `opus`) or a full model id. Also editable from **Models & effort** in the MALT Reviewer view. Applies when the reviewer restarts.

enumDescriptions: The provider's own default (no effort flag)

malt.reviewer.maxConcurrentReviews.description: Initial reviewer agents across all call types (default 2). No fixed maximum. Restart the reviewer to apply; add or stop agents from Reviewers health for the current session.

malt.reviewer.claudePath.markdownDescription: Path to the Claude Code CLI, used by the host backend. Machine-level only: a repository's workspace settings can never set this, because it decides what MALT runs or connects to.

malt.docker.socketPath.markdownDescription: Docker Engine socket or named pipe. Empty uses DOCKER_HOST or the platform default. Machine-level only: a repository's workspace settings can never set this, because it decides what MALT runs or connects to.

malt.changes.autoOpen.description: Bring a file into view (without taking focus) when new changes appear in it. Paused while you are working; see Auto Open Pause Seconds.

malt.changes.autoOpenPauseSeconds.markdownDescription: While you are working (clicking, typing, scrolling, switching files, or opening something from MALT), auto-open waits until you have been idle this many seconds, so it never pulls you away from what you are investigating. New changes still appear in **Changes** right away.

malt.changes.autoReview.description: Review each new changed block automatically.

malt.changes.autoConsolidation.description: Check the whole change for code that should be consolidated (one reviewer call) 30 seconds after new files stop appearing.
